scope: fixture and test contract only; routecodex-5 integrates. Do not edit cooldown owner files or cool-0906.

must: After provider glm HTTP 400 invalid_request/content-required, switch immediately to the next available provider/model and continue the original request.
The 400 stays only in internal observability/provider_failure_events (and runtime error handling). Client-projected error_chain remains absent on success.
Client HTTP status is never 400 and never a wrapped 502.
Attempt 2 provider-request payload equals attempt 1 except selected model/wire_name. No payload guessing or content-field rewrite.
must_not: Cooldown, ProbeSuccess, or provider.key.model blocking as pass criteria.
Client HTTP 400 when a next candidate is available.
Client HTTP 502 wrapping of the glm 400.

non_goals: Do not treat request_local_provider_compat reclassification as this fixture's pass/fail.
Do not require cooldown_until or ProbeSuccess before the sibling model is attempted.

Do not implement exhausted-only projection here. First dispatch 'exhausted keep external 400' is superseded: client still must not see 400 or wrapped 502, but the exhausted status is unspecified beyond those two bans.

owner_binding_for_r5.existing_closeout_lock: responses_relay_provider_context_error_reselects_next_candidate_before_projection covers 400 then different-provider 200. Do not edit hub_relay_runtime_closeout.rs from this tree.
owner_binding_for_r5.unique_gap: Same provider+key, different models: goaichat:key1:glm-5.3 HTTP400 then goaichat:key1:qwen3.8-max 200.

assertions.captures: attempt1 model glm-5.3 HTTP400; attempt2 model qwen3.8-max HTTP200; input field identical

blackbox.same_entry_replay: If sample RID is restored under openai-responses ports, replay the original client request. Client status must be 200, never 400, never 502. Provider glm 400 must remain in debug/observability only.
blackbox.http_surface: Client /v1/responses must not return HTTP 400 or a 502 wrapper after a recoverable goaichat glm 400 when qwen3.8-max remains available.

r5_integration_warning: If cooldown is applied at provider+key (not provider+key+model) after glm 400, qwen on the same key will be skipped and this contract turns red. That is an integration defect against m1788710112409-56, not a reason to rewrite payload.
